title: Eastern Governorate Completes Universal Access Projects in Early 2021
summary: The Eastern Governorate of Saudi Arabia announced the completion of universal access projects in early 2021, focusing on infrastructure that supports individuals with disabilities.
body:
The Eastern Governorate of Saudi Arabia announced the completion of universal access projects in early 2021, focusing on infrastructure that supports individuals with disabilities.

title: March at the foot of the Pyramids calls for access to assistive technologies for people with disabilities
summary: A United Nations Development Programme press release highlights a march held at the foot of the Pyramids, demanding improved access to assistive technologies for individuals with disabilities.
body:
A United Nations Development Programme press release highlights a march held at the foot of the Pyramids, demanding improved access to assistive technologies for individuals with disabilities.
